significance.justification: Verified true, the conclusion would be that the "number/strength of the model's own concessions" causally predicts and accounts for more refusal-projection erosion than "user benign context," and that removing this component restores refusal; this is a form-(iii) comparative dose-response relation combined with a form-(ii) causal mechanism. It establishes both a behavioral phenomenon—progressive refusal erosion—and a mechanistic decomposition into self-consistency and context-dilution pathways, constraining explanations and defense choices beyond the single-direction refusal mechanism characterized by Arditi et al. and the progressive attack behavior documented by Crescendo. A negative result that specifically rejects the claimed dominant self-consistency pathway would informatively shift explanation toward context dilution, final-query disguise, or attack-family heterogeneity, although failure of the full conjunction would not by itself distinguish among all these alternatives; the dominant-pathway comparison is nevertheless determinate. Topic-substitution check: replacing this decomposition with the generic goal of mechanistic LLM safety would not justify this score—the above-median value comes specifically from the claimed ordering and causal dose-response between two independently manipulable sources of erosion.

reach.justification: The named handle is "conversational memory hygiene," which "re-projects or masks the self-generated concession component" before generating a later turn; the associated concession strength and refusal-direction projection also provide a measurable warning signal. This is ex ante rather than merely post hoc because it acts on accumulated concessions before the next potentially harmful response, giving auditors or deployers of open-weight conversational systems an intervention window. After per-model re-extraction, the conclusion predicts a transferable relation—erosion should track the model's own commitment more strongly than benign-context volume—rather than merely supplying a procedure for searching, though the stated uncertainty about frontier-model transfer limits the asserted scope to multiple open-weight chat models and attack families. Topic-substitution check: generic mechanistic safety would not supply this before-generation memory intervention or comparative predictor, so the score rests on claim-specific handles rather than the importance of LLM safety itself.
